generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders.

All Scanned Documents of the Original should be up-loaded, inviting authority reserves the right to verify the Original Documents before approval, 0riginal documents / Certificates for qualification shall be produced as and when called for during evaluation of tender
Financial turnover and similar nature of work done of previous years shall be given a weight age of 10 per year to bring them to the price level of the 2021-26
Work done certificate should be signed by competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent.
The Tendered should maintain the Work during defect liability period as indicated in The Contract Data
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake.
The Tender Inviting Authority reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
The bill payment is subject to satisfactory submission of third party inspection report to this office.
The status of work should be submitted along with photographs in three stages. Failure of which the bill payment will not be made
GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Corrigendum / Modifications / Correction, if any, will be published in the website only.
The tendered should abide by all the terms and conditions laid under Standard Bid Document as per KTPP Act.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Valid PWD license of appropriate class
Annual Turnover Certificate duly signed by C A during last five years out of which two years turnover will be considered and turnover certificate should bear UDID No
Similar nature of 50 percentage estimated cost work done duly counter signed by not a below the rank of EE or equivalent.
Line of Credit 30 percentage of the tender Amount Rs.124403.00 from Nationalized Bank/Schedule Bank & Conditional Bankers certificate are not accepted

itemList.description: Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground without blasting for all works other than foundation in Ordinary/ Soft rock & depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery and other appurtenances required to complete the work In Ordinary/Soft rock upto 300 mm depth m 362.00 [P-8/I-1.13/Vol-II/2023-24]

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. Distempering with oil bound washable distemper of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :New work (two coats) over and including water thinnable priming coat with cement primer after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
